extracted.intended_audience: researchers and authors preparing clinical trial protocols, trial methodologists, journal editors and peer reviewers assessing trial protocols
extracted.subtask_description: Use the SPIRIT 2025 reporting guideline and its extensions to define and report standard protocol items for randomized clinical trials (whole-protocol reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT 2025 Checklist: Defining standard protocol items for clinical trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Defining standard protocol items for clinical trials. (SPIRIT 2025 statement: updated guideline for protocols of randomized trials.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary reporting guideline for protocol content; checklist available for download from the CONSORT-SPIRIT website. Published simultaneously in multiple journals (BMJ, JAMA, Lancet, Nat Med, PLoS Med). See also the SPIRIT 2025 explanation and elaboration paper (BMJ 2025) for detailed guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: protocol-whole report
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies to the whole report or to individual sections of the report? Protocol-whole report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2025 is intended to be applied across the complete trial protocol rather than only to isolated sections; use the checklist to ensure all protocol items are addressed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study design applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: Study design: Clinical trials, Experimental studies, Study protocols.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SPIRIT 2025 is targeted at randomized trials and related experimental study protocols; authors of such study designs should use the checklist to prepare complete protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-PRO (Patient-Reported Outcomes extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for Inclusion of Patient-Reported Outcomes in Clinical Trial Protocols: The SPIRIT-PRO Extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPIRIT-PRO when the trial protocol includes patient-reported outcomes to ensure appropriate specification and reporting of PRO objectives, measures, timing, data collection and analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-TCM (Traditional Chinese Medicine extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard Protocol Items for Clinical Trials with Traditional Chinese Medicine 2018: Recommendations, Explanation and Elaboration (SPIRIT-TCM Extension 2018).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this extension for protocols of trials involving Traditional Chinese Medicine to capture TCM‑specific items and rationale.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPENT 2019 (n-of-1 trials extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: SPIRIT extension and elaboration for n-of-1 trials: SPENT 2019 checklist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPENT when preparing n-of-1 trial protocols to address design, conduct, and reporting items specific to single-patient randomized crossover trials.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-AI (artificial intelligence extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for clinical trial protocols for interventions involving artificial intelligence: the SPIRIT-AI Extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply SPIRIT-AI for protocols of trials where the intervention involves AI to ensure clear reporting of AI system characteristics, data, training, evaluation and monitoring details relevant to trial integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Path (cellular and molecular pathology content extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for cellular and molecular pathology content in clinical trial protocols: the SPIRIT-Path extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPIRIT-Path to ensure pathology-specific protocol items (specimen handling, assays, quality control) are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Outcomes (outcomes reporting extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines for Reporting Outcomes in Trial Protocols: The SPIRIT-Outcomes Extension (2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply SPIRIT-Outcomes to comprehensively specify outcome definitions, measurement methods, timing, prioritization, and analysis plans in protocols.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-DEFINE (dose-finding extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhancing quality and impact of early phase dose-finding clinical trial protocols: SPIRIT Dose-finding Extension (SPIRIT-DEFINE) guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPIRIT-DEFINE for early-phase dose-finding trials to report dose-escalation/de-escalation rules, stopping criteria, model-based methods and safety monitoring specific to dose-finding.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT Factorial (factorial trial extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consensus Statement for Protocols of Factorial Randomized Trials: Extension of the SPIRIT 2013 Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this extension for factorial randomized trial protocols to address factorial-specific design, interaction assessment, allocation and analysis considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-Surrogate (surrogate endpoint extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting of surrogate endpoints in randomised controlled trial protocols (SPIRIT-Surrogate): extension checklist with explanation and elaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use SPIRIT-Surrogate when protocols rely on surrogate endpoints to ensure reporting of surrogate validation, rationale, limitations and interpretation plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: SPIRIT-iNeurostim (implantable neurostimulation devices extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting guidelines for protocols of randomised controlled trials of implantable neurostimulation devices: the SPIRIT-iNeurostim extension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply SPIRIT-iNeurostim for trials of implantable neurostimulation devices to ensure device-specific protocol items (device description, implantation, programming, monitoring, safety) are reported.
